title: Replace coach photo at section 4 with new uploaded image

requirements.summary: Replace the existing coach photo in section 4 of the AboutCoach page with the new uploaded image (IMG_1635.jpeg) showing Coach Yash in a black fleece jacket holding a volleyball
acceptanceCriteria: The new image file exists at 'frontend/public/assets/generated/coach-yash-bhardwaj-v2.dim_800x800.jpg'
The img src at the targeted XPath location points to '/assets/generated/coach-yash-bhardwaj-v2.dim_800x800.jpg'
The old coach photo (coach-yash-bhardwaj.dim_800x800.jpg) is no longer referenced in the AboutCoach component
The image renders visibly with object-fit: cover and explicit width/height styling

file_operations.description: Locate the image element within section 4 (the fourth section div inside the main container at /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/section[4]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[1]) that currently references 'coach-yash-bhardwaj.dim_800x800.jpg'. Replace the src attribute to point to the new asset '/assets/generated/coach-yash-bhardwaj-v2.dim_800x800.jpg'. Ensure the img element has explicit width and height attributes (800x800) and includes object-fit: cover styling (either inline style or className) so the image is fully visible and properly cropped. Remove any references to the old coach-yash-bhardwaj.dim_800x800.jpg filename from the component.
